dct_description_sm: This data set contains information on demolished buildings in New Westminster, including building attributes (size etc.), location and when they were demolished. Some of the buildings demolished in earlier years (e.g., prior to 2000) may be missing much of the information on attributes. This data set is based on the information contained within the City of New Westminster’s Geographic Information System.
